title: Merumatta Half Marathon 2026 Review: A Hotel-Backed Coastal Race in Lombok
seo_title: Merumatta Half Marathon 2026 Review | Senggigi, Lombok
meta_description: Merumatta Half Marathon 2026 review: October 18 at Merumatta Hotel, Senggigi -- a 390m-elevation coastal race in Lombok's original tourist strip.
dek: Set for 18 October 2026 at Merumatta Hotel in Senggigi, this hotel-backed race carries a genuine 390-metre elevation gain along Lombok's original tourist beachfront strip, north of the capital Mataram.
verdict: The Merumatta Half Marathon is hotel-backed -- organised by Merumatta Coast Trail, tied to the Merumatta Hotel in Senggigi -- and carries a real physical challenge: 390 metres of elevation gain on the half marathon distance, a genuinely hilly course by regional standards. Four distances (21.1K down to 2.5K) give it broader accessibility despite the terrain. Senggigi itself has a distinctive history: once hyped as 'the next Bali' in the late 1990s, it was set back by the 2000 communal violence and 2002 Bali bombing, and has since fallen behind newer Lombok destinations -- giving the area a quieter, less-crowded beachfront character today.

sections.heading: A Hotel-Backed Race With Real Elevation
paragraphs: The race is organised by Merumatta Coast Trail at Merumatta Hotel, Senggigi, Lombok Barat, offering four distances: 21.1K, 10K, 5K and 2.5K, with 390 metres of elevation gain on the half marathon. [1] That's a genuinely hilly course by the standards of most races in this research batch -- runners chasing a flat PR should look elsewhere, but those wanting a scenic, challenging coastal route will find real terrain here.

sections.heading: Senggigi: Lombok's Original Tourist Strip
paragraphs: Senggigi was once Lombok's main tourist strip, stretching along several kilometres of beachfront just north of the capital, Mataram, and saw a building boom in the late 1990s when the island was hyped as 'the next Bali.' [2] The communal violence of 2000 and the 2002 Bali bombing dealt the area a severe blow, with tourist numbers declining sharply and many construction projects halted. Senggigi has since fallen behind Kuta Lombok in the south and the Gili Islands in the northwest in terms of popularity and development.

sections.heading: A Quieter Coastal Destination Today
paragraphs: That history means Senggigi today offers a genuinely quieter, less-crowded beachfront experience than Lombok's newer, more heavily developed tourist zones -- notable attractions include Pura Batu Bolong, a Hindu temple built into a beachside rock formation. [2] For runners who prefer a coastal race destination without the intensity of a peak tourist hub, that's a real advantage.

sections.heading: Registration and Distance Range
paragraphs: Registration is currently open across all four distances. [1] The 2.5K category in particular makes this accessible to families or casual participants who want to be part of race weekend without tackling the hillier longer distances.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a genuinely challenging, hotel-backed coastal race in a quieter corner of Lombok appeals -- especially if you want real elevation rather than a flat course -- the Merumatta Half Marathon on 18 October 2026 is a strong pick. Registration is open now across four accessible distances.
